date_basis: Each listing's last_scraped date. Established means first_review <= last_scraped minus 365 days; the review-count window is (last_scraped minus 365 days, last_scraped]. This does not establish a launch date or continuous operation.
quantile_method: R type 7 / NumPy linear; round upward for an integer review-count event

benchmark_partition.canonical_host_id: Expand scientific-notation text as an exact decimal integer without conversion through floating point. This cannot recover precision already lost upstream.
benchmark_partition.usage: Benchmark hosts supply the common cutoff only and are excluded from all model training, OOF evaluation and sensitivity analysis pools.

segment_support: Apply all eligibility filters and remove benchmark hosts, then retain segments with at least 50 analysis listings. Benchmark rows must satisfy primary eligibility and belong to these retained primary segments.
threshold_usage: Compute the pooled benchmark-development P75 once; hold the resulting integer cutoff fixed across all segments, models and sensitivity samples. Analysis-pool outcomes do not determine this cutoff.
exploratory_status: This revised design follows prior exploration of the supplied snapshot. Computational separation does not create a previously untouched final test or remove the influence of earlier research choices.
source_review_count_note: The supplied number_of_reviews_ltm matches the inclusive 366-date window [last_scraped - 365 days, last_scraped]. Preserve it and derive reviews_365d from raw dates using the open-left 365-day window.
